external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization that is a tenant of the invoicing service.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and accesses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console from the support office network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users, payers, and support agents to access and modify invoicing data.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether it checks invoice ownership when loading by invoice number. Nobody wrote down whether it checks the user's role again when a request arrives.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes generated PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by each job.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console reachable from the support office network that lets support agents open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: The admin console is reachable only from there

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: The database has no row-level security. Nobody recorded how it is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket storing generated PDFs under company IDs and invoice numbers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
data_stores.notes: Nobody recorded how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The customer user submits login credentials to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.data_description: Email address, password, and resulting session cookie

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: The customer user uses the billing app over HTTPS to access invoicing functions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.notes: The pages hide buttons a viewer may not use. Nobody wrote down whether the billing app checks the user's role again when a request arrives.
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: The customer user submits the whole invoice to the billing app for saving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back
data_flows.notes: The billing app saves every field it receives, including the paid flag and the company's payout bank account.
data_flows.data_description: Whole invoice, including paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: The customer user requests a PDF for an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice number and PDF request

data_flows.name: query invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and saves tenant records in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer records, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a render job on the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.data_description: Invoice identified by company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a generated PDF to the bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries.
data_flows.data_description: Generated invoice PDF, stored under company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: One service credential is used for all companies.
data_flows.data_description: Generated invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing an invoice number

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: The payer opens the payment page and receives the invoice, company name, and bank details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console with an account and one-time code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Support-agent account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a selected customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and actions performed through it

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud platform where the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: customer company tenant
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary; each customer company is one tenant.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data because it stores invoices, customer records, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly names invoices, customers, and payout bank details as database contents.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data because it stores generated invoice PDFs.
assumptions.basis: The source says the renderer writes invoice PDFs to the PDF bucket; invoices and bank details are confidential business and financial data.

assumptions.assumption: The render queue contains confidential data because its jobs carry company IDs and invoice numbers associated with invoices.
assumptions.basis: The source says render jobs carry a company ID and invoice number for generating invoice PDFs.

assumptions.assumption: The admin console has internal exposure because it is reachable only from the support office network.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly says the admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The cloud platform is a network trust zone because the shared application and storage components are described as running there.
assumptions.basis: The source places the shared billing app, database, and PDF bucket in the organization's cloud platform, indicating a same-party network/location boundary.
